notes.title: Update: Official Soundtrack Included!
notes.notes:
It brings me so much joy to read the wonderful reviews you guys have given my game. So here's a little chance to give something back: 

The latest update of Milkmaid includes the full soundtrack as high-quality MP3 files! 
Check the soundtrack folder in your game folder.

Also, the game price has been reduced to line up better with the iOS price. Again, thanks for all the great feedback - and if you haven't already played Milkmaid, this is the perfect time to get the game!

Best,
Mattis

notes.title: A small update
notes.notes:
I just uploaded a patch that fixes a few minor things:

- Fixed two minor puzzle bugs
- Tweaked the walking zones in the fields so Ruth hopefully won't glitch 
- Fixed some annoying typos (thanks lancelot)

Also: Thanks so much for the nice feedback and comments on my game! Really appreciate it!

New patch out January 8:
- The cursor now animates when you hover over interactions, and lets you know when you can't click (ie. cutscenes). Also shows a little better when you use objects in your inventory.
- Pathfinding has been tweaked, hopefully Ruth will walk and run properly at all times.
